integrity.checks: Proof by conditional moments, exact beta integrals, asymptotic dominated integral; standalone symbolic, quadrature and simulation checks.

scientific_limitations: The exact crossover is for dimension four, a rank-one Gaussian sketch, one independent Gaussian residual probe, and three Gaussian direct quadratic probes at a three-multiplication budget.
The large-spike asymptotic holds for each fixed dimension, not uniformly with dimension.
No comparisons with Rademacher probes, Nyström++, adaptive allocations, or all possible trace-estimation algorithms are asserted.
title: A sharp three-query Gaussian Hutch++ crossover on spiked matrices
